name: Free the Captives
summary: Four captives are shackled in the Dead Larder, each with Exhaustion, waiting for the next pyre.

stages.journal: Axel Farley and three others hang shackled in the freezing larder. Taking a captive out of the grounds without leave counts against us if the faithful see.
stages.hint: Free them without being seen, or lead them out the gate.

stages.journal: Axel and the others are free and on the road to Dawn's Gate.
We led the captives out in plain sight, and the faithful noticed.
